title: a16z Podcast: Startups and Pendulum Swings Through Ideas, Time, Fame, and Money

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Everything old is new again when it comes to startup ideas and how technology innovation happens.
reader_summary.overview: Everything old is new again when it comes to startup ideas and how technology innovation happens. But practically, how does that apply to starting and/or working at startups — especially since the default state of every company is “dying in obscurity”? In this episode of the a16z Podcast.

key_points.text: In this episode of the a16z Podcast.
They also discuss the VC “formula” of weighting product vs.
team; the full-stack approach to cracking industries that tech could never enter before; and recent tech trends and news including The DAO, AI.
